payload.label: Comments and messages on an Instagram professional account

signature.notes: Meta signs each delivery with the secret of the app the webhook belongs to; for Instagram Login that is the Instagram app secret, the same value the sign-in exchange uses, so it is held once.

handshake.notes: Meta confirms the callback address with a GET carrying these query fields; the expected value is typed into the Meta app's webhook settings as its Verify Token. It is not what keeps deliveries honest: every POST must carry the app's signature.

Bookmarks on an X account
payload.notes: X keeps no time a bookmark was made and has no address to send new ones to, so Trillion reads them: listening starts by saving every bookmark X hands out into the person's files (tool:save-x-bookmarks without since), which names the newest; each later read saves and returns only the bookmarks above that one. Every read is billed to the X app's credits, so it runs every 30 minutes.
